name: std/sequence
description: Builds typed sequences and applies ordering, searching, and transformations.
readme: Builds typed sequences and applies ordering, searching, and transformations.
Import this module with use sequence.

modules.name: std/sequence
modules.summary: Builds typed sequences and applies ordering, searching, and transformations.

items.name: append
items.signature: public use "sequence" function append[T](items of type sequence of T, value of type T) of type fallible sequence of T.

items.name: copy
items.signature: public use "sequence" function copy[T](items of type sequence of T) of type fallible sequence of T.

items.name: create
items.signature: public use "sequence" function create[T]() of type sequence of T.
items.documentation: Builds typed sequences and applies ordering, searching, and transformations.

items.name: dedup
items.signature: public function dedup[T](items sequence of T) giving fallible sequence of T where T is Equatable.

items.name: deduplicate
items.signature: public function deduplicate[T](items sequence of T) giving fallible sequence of T where T is Equatable.

items.name: filter
items.signature: public function filter[T](items of type sequence of T, predicate of type function taking (T) giving boolean) of type fallible sequence of T.

items.name: find
items.signature: public function find[T](items of type sequence of T, value of type T) of type optional unsigned 64 where T is Equatable.

items.name: length
items.signature: public use "sequence" function length[T](items of type sequence of T) of type unsigned 64.

items.name: map
items.signature: public function map[T, U](items of type sequence of T, transform of type function taking (T) giving U) of type fallible sequence of U.

items.name: release
items.signature: public use "sequence" function release[T](items of type sequence of T) of type fallible nothing.

items.name: remove
items.signature: public use "sequence" function remove[T](items of type sequence of T, index of type unsigned 64) of type fallible sequence of T.

items.name: sort
items.signature: public function sort[T](items of type sequence of T) of type fallible sequence of T where T is Ord.
